description: This file contains partial class definitions and extension methods related to AdoNet streaming configuration within Orleans. It defines options classes, validators, and configurator classes for setting up AdoNet streams in Orleans clusters and silos, including methods for configuring cache, partitioning, and AdoNet-specific options.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for AdoNet streaming, including connection string, eviction policies, timeouts, and attempt limits.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for AdoNetStreamOptions, implementing configuration validation logic.

classes.name: ClusterClientAdoNetStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for setting up AdoNet streams on Orleans cluster clients, including methods for configuring AdoNet options, cache, and partitioning.

classes.name: SiloAdoNetStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for setting up AdoNet streams on Orleans silos, including methods for configuring AdoNet options, cache, and partitioning.

methods.name: ConfigureAdoNet
methods.description: Configures AdoNet options using a provided options builder.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Configures cache size for AdoNet streams.

methods.name: AddAdoNetStreams
methods.description: Extension methods to add AdoNet streams to Orleans client or silo builders with configuration options.
